title: Abelian dynamical Galois groups over global function fields
summary: We establish a function field analogue of a recent conjecture of Andrews--Petsche. Our main result characterizes abelian dynamical Galois groups to be precisely the isotrivial ones, whenever the degree of the polynomial is smaller than $p$, the characteristic of the field. The proof of this characterization is achieved in four independent steps as follows: $$\text{Abelian} \implies \text{Finite ramification} \implies \text{PCF map} \implies \text{Isotrivial map} \implies \text{Isotrivial pair}, $$ and works more generally for maps with a superattracting fixed point.
